metadata.source: RDP Activity Originating from Unmanaged Device.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: RDP Activity Originating from Unmanaged Device
properties.description:
Detects RDP activity originating from unmanaged devices by comparing the
remote session source against Microsoft Defender onboarded device inventory
and an approved device watchlist. This detection helps identify remote
access from systems that are not known or managed within the environment.
properties.query:
let InventoryLookback = 30d;
let ManagedDevices =
DeviceInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(InventoryLookback)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus in ("Onboarded", "Insufficient info")
| where isnotempty(DeviceName)
| extend NormalizedDevice =
tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]))
| distinct NormalizedDevice;
let ApprovedDevices =
_GetWatchlist('ApprovedRDPSourceDevices')
| project ApprovedDevice = tolower(SearchKey);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession == true
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName)
| extend SourceDevice =
tolower(tostring(split(InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName, ".")[0]))
| where SourceDevice !in (ManagedDevices)
| where SourceDevice !in (ApprovedDevices | project ApprovedDevice)
| summarize
    EventCount = count(),
    TargetDeviceCount = dcount(DeviceName),
    TargetDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 20),
    AccountsUsed = make_set(AccountName, 20),
    ProcessesExecuted = make_set(FileName, 20),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by
    SourceDevice,
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName,
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP
| order by EventCount desc
